photos.desc: Wild cucumber growing on Salix bebbiana (Bebb willow) and Symphoricarpos occidentalis (western snowberry) along the Gallagator Linear trail south of Story Mill Park, Bozeman, Montana.
Prickly cucumber at full anthesis on 31 July 2022. The site was aromatic because of the flowers. This site lies along the trail south of Story Mill Park, Bozeman, Montana.
